name: HR Agent Multi-Turn Trajectory Evaluation Suite
description: Multi-turn conversational trajectories validating state preservation, context carryover, confirmation loops, and multi-step complex workflows across HR specialist subagents.

eval_cases.description: User requests leave without specifying dates; agent prompts for dates, confirms balance, and executes booking upon confirmation.

turns.user_input: I need to take some vacation time off next month.
turns.expected_agent_response: I can help you book vacation leave. Could you please provide your exact start date and end date (in YYYY-MM-DD format)? For your reference, you currently have 15.0 days of vacation remaining in WorkWeek.
You requested 3 days of Vacation leave from 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-07. You have 15.0 days available. Would you like me to go ahead and submit this request in WorkWeek?
Your vacation request for 3 days from 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-07 has been successfully submitted in WorkWeek. Your updated remaining vacation balance is 12.0 days.

eval_cases.description: User inquires about bereavement policy, agent checks entitlement, books compassionate leave in WorkWeek, and creates coverage ticket in ServiceImmediately.

turns.user_input: My grandfather passed away in Singapore. What compassionate leave am I entitled to?
turns.expected_agent_response:
I am sorry for your loss. Under the Bereavement Leave Policy, employees are entitled to up to 3 consecutive days of paid compassionate bereavement leave for the loss of extended family members (including grandparents).

`policy://03-other-compassionate-unpaid-leaves/3.1-bereavement-leave-global`

turns.user_input: Please log these 3 days for me from 2026-09-07 to 2026-09-09.
turns.expected_agent_response: I have submitted your 3-day Compassionate Bereavement leave request in WorkWeek from 2026-09-07 to 2026-09-09. Please take all the time you need.

turns.user_input: Can you also open an IT ticket to set an out-of-office autoreply on my Outlook account?
turns.expected_agent_response: I have created an Access ticket INC0002620 in ServiceImmediately requesting Out-of-Office autoresponder activation on your email account from 2026-09-07 to 2026-09-09.

eval_cases.description: Multi-turn IT troubleshooting progressing from checking existing tickets to appending comments and updating ticket status.

turns.user_input: What is the latest update on my hardware ticket INC0002551?
turns.expected_agent_response: Ticket INC0002551 ('External 4K Monitor flickering') is currently **In Progress** assigned to IT Hardware Support.

turns.user_input: IT delivered a replacement monitor this morning and it is working perfectly.
turns.expected_agent_response: Glad to hear that! Would you like me to add a confirmation comment and resolve ticket INC0002551 for you?
I have updated ticket INC0002551 status to **Resolved** with resolution notes: 'Replacement monitor received and verified working'.
